not_confirmed_list.value: Marisol Valvulas manufactures industrial gate and globe valves for the oil and gas industry and exports to customers across Europe.
Ostwind Armaturen manufactures pneumatic control valves for district heating networks and serves customers in Germany, Austria and Switzerland.
Hansa Valve Supply is an independent distributor of industrial valves from European manufacturers, keeping items in stock. It states it does not manufacture valves itself.
Złoty Kłos produces packaged bread, rolls and pastries for supermarket chains. Its bakery plant is located in Poznań, Poland.
Mała Piekarnia runs five neighbourhood bakery shops in Kraków, Poland, baking fresh every morning and selling only in its own shops.
